summary: Iteration 20 verifies the richer Corners/Cards coverage + player 'To assist' and 'To be carded' rows (Sportmonks for Scottish Premiership + Danish Superliga, plus API-Football 3-way Corner markets for other leagues) are correctly priced, that whole-number corner/card lines are allowed only where a bookmaker quotes them, and that no whole-number priced line leaks into Goals / First-Half / Team Goals / player props. All regression invariants (4 unpriced-market panels still show the explanatory note, LION tickets Greek-only and parlay-math-correct, /api/value-matches populated, picks.js settleStatus) also hold. Backend: 37/37 pytest. Frontend unit test for settleStatus: 13/13. Frontend UI (Specific Bets for Odense vs Brondby): 98 .gr links across bet365.gr + novibet.gr, 4 'No bookmaker prices this market for this fixture' notes, snapshot banner visible, Corners panel renders ~25 rows and Cards panel renders fully.

evidence.picks_js_unit_tests: 13/13 passed (whole-number corners/cards settle won/lost, home_under_1.5 settles)
fixtures_tested: live_af_1549037 (Odense vs Brondby, Superliga Denmark - Sportmonks coverage)
live_af_1575188 (Union Berlin vs Dortmund, Bundesliga - API-Football 3-way corners)

critical_code_review_comments: specific_bets._lines() now returns ONLY bookmaker-quoted rows AND _af_pick accepts whole-number lines when the market is explicitly 3-way (fixes the earlier 'single quoted line' limitation). For Bundesliga/Championship fixtures this immediately exposed ~20 whole-number corner lines; for Scottish/Danish fixtures the richer Sportmonks catalogue drives even more rows.

pick id formatting switched to {line:g}, so 'corners_over_5' (not 'corners_over_5.0') correctly resolves against the model row id — this was the root cause of integer-line rows appearing unpriced in iteration 19.

sportmonks_odds._sm_pick correctly handles the alternative corner/card markets, correct score, team totals, BTTS and player markets (Goalscorer, Player to Assist, Player to be booked, Shots/SOT); it also canonicalises 'bet365' -> 'Bet365' with capital B as the UI expects. Date index with 6h cache + 150 calls/hour cap looks safe.

picks.js ou() now treats whole-number lines as 3-way (hit-line loses both sides) so corners_over_8 / cards_over_4 settle won/lost rather than void — verified by 13 unit tests. Team-total regex generalised to over|under so under lines (home_under_1.5) now settle correctly.

4 markets no .gr book quotes (Score At Any Time, Fouls, Offsides, Goalkeeper Saves) stay unpriced BY DESIGN and still display 'No bookmaker prices this market for this fixture — LION's own probability only.' — confirmed on all 3 fixtures.
LION tickets: parlay odds <= product(leg odds)+0.01 holds for all 25 parlays; max legs=6 as specified; every leg bookmaker is in the Greek-licensed allowlist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Canonical fixtures for Sportmonks coverage: live_af_1549037 (Odense vs Brondby, Danish Superliga - gives ~73/88 priced player rows including To Assist and To Be Carded, Corners 24/24 priced, bookmakers Bet365 + Novibet). For API-Football 3-way whole-number corners regression use live_af_1575188 (Union Berlin vs Dortmund, Bundesliga - Corners 22/22 of which 20 are whole-number). The 4 unpriced panels (Score At Any Time, Fouls, Offsides, Goalkeeper Saves) are design-correct and still carry the explanatory note. VITE_BACKEND_URL is set in /app/frontend/.env (not REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — the project is on Vite). Credit budget: /api/specific-bets took ~10s cold then <2s cached; /api/lion-tickets responded <1s from snapshot. One pytest run of this file costs ~0 fresh provider calls thanks to 30-min odds cache + DB snapshot.
rca of the issue: User's 'wrong mapping, couldn't match them because named differently' was resolved by sportmonks_odds.py which (a) adds a 1-call/day date index with fuzzy fixture matching (FC Kobenhavn <-> FC Copenhagen, AGF <-> Aarhus) so the Sportmonks catalogue actually matches our fixtures for Scottish Premiership and Danish Superliga, (b) maps Sportmonks alternative Corners/Cards/Correct Score/Team Totals/BTTS/Goalscorer/Assist/Shots/SOT/Booked markets into our pick ids and (c) merges after API-Football while keeping the Greek-licensed-book whitelist. The earlier Corners/Cards integer-line pricing bug (iter19) is now fixed by {line:g} formatting + apifootball._af_pick accepting whole-number lines when the market is explicitly 3-way.
